    'v1'
      || '~' || translate(rtrim(replace(encode(convert_to('source_scope', 'UTF8'), 'base64'), E'\n', ''), '='), '+/', '-_')
      || '.s.' || translate(rtrim(replace(encode(convert_to(e.metadata->>'source_scope', 'UTF8'), 'base64'), E'\n', ''), '='), '+/', '-_')
      || '~' || translate(rtrim(replace(encode(convert_to('source_origin_id', 'UTF8'), 'base64'), E'\n', ''), '='), '+/', '-_')
      || '.s.' || translate(rtrim(replace(encode(convert_to(e.metadata->>'source_origin_id', 'UTF8'), 'base64'), E'\n', ''), '='), '+/', '-_')
      || '~' || translate(rtrim(replace(encode(convert_to('task_key', 'UTF8'), 'base64'), E'\n', ''), '='), '+/', '-_')
      || '.s.' || translate(rtrim(replace(encode(convert_to(e.metadata->>'task_key', 'UTF8'), 'base64'), E'\n', ''), '='), '+/', '-_')

  JOIN entity_types et ON et.id = e.entity_type_id

    AND ei.namespace = 'watcher_key'

    AND octet_length(e.metadata->>'source_origin_id') <= 256
